title: Mixed Conditionals / Condicionales Mixtos
bridge: A cikin turanci, ba wanda ya yi wata alama mai haske da dama ga condicionales mixtos: muna yin haɗin da yawa na fasaha da yawa da suka nuna wata hanyar bayyana wata kalma mai yuwuwa tare da sabon fasaha ko wata kalma mai yuwuwa tare da fasaha da ta gabata. A cikin turanci, wannan haɗin ya kamata ya dace da wata tsarin fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha. Tsarin da ke da alama mai yuwuwa (if-clause) da apodosis (main clause) suna yin fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha da fasaha. Muna da wata matsala mai yawa saboda ba zaku iya fassarawa daidai da condicionales na turanci ba; ya kamata ku sami tsarin kowane daga cikin biyu na haɗin da suka dace da kowane wata lokaci da suka dace da wata lokaci.
rule: Condicionales mixtos suna haɗa wata yuwuwa a gabata tare da sabon fasaha (type 3 + type 2) ko wata yuwuwa a yanzu tare da sabon fasaha a gabata (type 2 + type 3). Tsarin 1: If + past perfect, would + base verb (yuwuwa a gabata, sabon fasaha a yanzu). Misali: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now. Tsarin 2: If + simple past, would have + past participle (yuwuwa a yanzu, sabon fasaha a gabata). Misali: If I were you, I would have told her the truth. Daidaituwa: A cikin condicional mixto, yana da alaka da yin amfani da 'were' a matsayin 'was' don dukan mutane a cikin yuwuwa a yanzu (If I were...). Kuma, tsarin da ke da alama mai yuwuwa na iya canza daidai ba tare da canje da ma'ana ba, amma alama da dama kawai yana da alama daidai da yanzu da yanzu. Amfani da yawa: bayyana damuwa, wasanni, ko shawara game da wata halayya da ta yuwuwa tare da sabon fasaha ko fasaha da gabata.

concept_examples.text: If I had studied more, I would be more confident now.
concept_examples.translation: Idan na koyi da yawa, yanzu zan da haduwa da damuwa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd ˈstʌdid mɔːr, aɪ wʊd biː mɔːr ˈkɑːnfɪdənt naʊ/

concept_examples.text: If she were more organized, she would have finished the project yesterday.
concept_examples.translation: Idan ta kasance mai tsarawa, ta kammala aikin jiya.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː wɜːr mɔːr ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd, ʃiː wʊd hæv ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə ˈprɒdʒekt ˈjestərdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: If I hadn't missed the flight, I wouldn't be stuck in this hotel.
concept_examples.translation: Idan ba zan rasa jirgin sama ba, ba zan kasance a wannan hotel.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ˈhædənt mɪst ðə flaɪt, aɪ ˈwʊdənt biː stʌk ɪn ðɪs hoʊˈtel/

concept_examples.text: If he were here, he would have solved the problem easily.
concept_examples.translation: Idan ya kasance nan, ya iya cire wannan matsala da sauki.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf hiː wɜːr hɪr, hiː wʊd hæv sɑːlvd ðə ˈprɑːbləm ˈiːzəli/

common_error.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct: If I had known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct_alt: Had I known, I would have told you.
common_error.explanation: Wannan matsala ce mai yawa a cikin mutanen da suka yi amfani da turanci saboda a cikin turanci ba a yi amfani da 'would' a cikin yuwuwa ba. A cikin yuwuwa (if-clause), muna yin amfani da 'past perfect' ba tare da 'would' ba. Don haka, da fatan za a kare wannan, da fatan za a kare wannan, da fatan za a kare wannan. Da fatan za a kare wannan, da fatan za a kare wannan, da fatan za a kare wannan.

levels.label: Mixed Conditional Type 1: Past Condition, Present Result
levels.translation: Condicional Mixto Type 1: Yuwuwa a Gabata, Sabon Fasaha a Yanzu

examples.original: If I had taken that job, I would be living in Madrid now.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd ˈteɪkən ðæt dʒɒb, aɪ wʊd biː ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn məˈdrɪd naʊ/
examples.translation: Idan na yi wannan aiki, yanzu zan kasance na rayuwarsa a Madrid.
examples.note: Yuwuwa ce a gabata (had taken) da sabon fasaha ce a yanzu (would be living). A turanci, an yi amfani da subjuntivo pluscuamperfecto a cikin yuwuwa da condicional simple a cikin sabon fasaha.

examples.original: If we hadn't argued, we would still be friends.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː ˈhædənt ˈɑːrɡjuːd, wiː wʊd stɪl biː frendz/
examples.translation: Idan ba muka yi wasa ba, duk da yaushe za mu kasance mace.
examples.note: An yi amfani da adverb 'still' (duk da yaushe) a cikin wannan type na condicional mixto don nuna cewa sabon fasaha yana da sabon fasaha a yanzu.

levels.label: Mixed Conditional Type 2: Present Condition, Past Result
levels.translation: Condicional Mixto Type 2: Yuwuwa a Yanzu, Sabon Fasaha a Gabata

examples.original: If I were more careful, I wouldn't have made that mistake.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr mɔːr ˈkerfəl, aɪ ˈwʊdənt hæv meɪd ðæt mɪˈsteɪk/
examples.translation: Idan na kasance mai haduwa, ba zan yi wannan kuskure ba.
examples.note: Yuwuwa ce a yanzu (if I were) da sabon fasaha ce a gabata (wouldn't have made). Da fatan za a kare wannan, da fatan za a kare wannan, da fatan za a kare wannan.

examples.original: If she spoke English better, she would have understood the movie.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː spoʊk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈbetər, ʃiː wʊd hæv ˌʌndərˈstʊd ðə ˈmuːvi/
examples.translation: Idan ta iya yin turanci da yawa, ta kammala fahimta da wannan filim.
examples.note: An yi amfani da 'if + simple past' don yuwuwa (yanzu) da 'would have + past participle' don sabon fasaha (a gabata). A turanci, dukan kalmomi suna a cikin subjuntivo/condicional.

examples.original: Had I known about the meeting, I would be there now.
examples.phonetic: /hæd aɪ noʊn əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ, aɪ wʊd biː ðer naʊ/
examples.translation: Idan na sani da wannan taron, yanzu zan kasance nan.
examples.note: Inversiyon mai haske ba tare da 'if' ba yana da alaka da yin amfani da fasaha mai haske da fasaha mai haske da fasaha mai haske. A wannan yanki, yuwuwa ce a gabata da sabon fasaha ce a yanzu.

examples.original: Were I in your position, I would have accepted the offer.
examples.phonetic: /wɜːr aɪ ɪn jɔːr pəˈzɪʃən, aɪ wʊd hæv əkˈseptɪd ði ˈɒfər/
examples.translation: Idan zan kasance a matsayinka, zan yi amfani da wannan offer.
examples.note: Tsarin da ke da inversiyon 'Were I...' yana da alaka da 'If I were...' da ya dace da wata alama mai haske. Wannan tsarin ya kamata ya dace da inversiyon da 'Had I...'.

examples.original: If you hadn't lied, we would trust you now.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf juː ˈhædənt laɪd, wiː wʊd trʌst juː naʊ/
examples.translation: Idan ba ka yi cika ba, duk da yaushe zan godewa da ku.
examples.note: Wannan misali yana nuna amfani mai yawa: wasanni da fasaha a gabata tare da sabon fasaha a yanzu. Kalmar 'trust' a cikin fasaha mai yuwuwa bayan 'would' yana da alaka da fasaha mai yuwuwa saboda yana nuna wata halayya mai yuwuwa.

title: Advanced Passive Voice: Gerunds, Infinitives, and Modals / Yanzu da wucewa mai tsanawa: gerunds, infinitives da modals
bridge: A cikin Espanyol, yanzu da wucewa yana hada da 'yi + wucewa' kuma ba a yi daidai da yadda ake amfani da modals ko shi ne a wucewarin da ba a matsayi ba (gerund/infinitive). A cikin Turanci, yanzu da wucewa ya fi yuwuwa: zaka iya da wucewa kamar 'must be done', 'being done', 'to be done', etc. Wata kuskure ce mai yawa wajen sauya tsarin Espanyol ne mai sauya, kamar 'debe ser hecho' a matsayin 'has to be done'. Ko da yaushe, a cikin Turanci, mai da wucewa yana kashewa (ba a ce 'by someone' idan ba ya da wahala ba), while a cikin Espanyol muna son yin amfani da shi da yawa.
rule: A cikin Turanci, yanzu da wucewa mai tsanawa yana hada da 'yi' a cikin yadda ake yin wucewa a cikin yadda ake yin wucewa a cikin yadda ake yin wucewa a cikin yadda ake yin wucewa. Don modals: modal + be + wucewa (misali, 'must be done', 'can be seen'). Don infinitives: to be + wucewa (misali, 'to be considered'). Don gerunds: being + wucewa (misali, 'being watched'). Da yadda ake yin wucewa da modals da yawa: modal + have been + wucewa (misali, 'should have been informed'). Wani wucewa ne da preposition: 'This chair was sat on' (har ma ba da yawa ba). Yi tsallake da yadda ake yin wucewa da yawa (intransitives) da kashewa da mai da wucewa: idan ba ya da wahala ba, an kashe shi. A cikin Espanyol, yanzu da wucewa ya fi tsanawa da kuma ya fi son yin amfani da wucewa mai tsanawa ko 'se'.

concept_examples.text: The report must be submitted by Friday.
concept_examples.translation: Yarjejeniyar ta dace da aiki zuwa ranar Jumma'a.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈpɔːrt mʌst biː səbˈmɪtɪd baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/

concept_examples.translation: Ta son a yi masa hotuna.

concept_examples.text: The problem needs to be solved immediately.
concept_examples.translation: Matsaloli ya bukata ya cire da sauke.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɑːbləm niːdz tə biː sɒlvd ɪˈmiːdiətli/

concept_examples.text: The package could have been delivered yesterday.
concept_examples.translation: Yarjejeniyar za ta iya kashewa a jiya.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈpækɪdʒ kʊd hæv biːn dɪˈlɪvərd ˈjestərdeɪ/

common_error.wrong: The problem must be solved *by us* immediately. (cuando no es necesario el agente)
common_error.correct: The problem must be solved immediately.
common_error.correct_alt: The problem has to be solved immediately.
common_error.explanation: Wanda ke yin amfani da harshen Espanyol suna addina mai da wucewa 'by someone' saboda a cikin Espanyol muna son addina 'por nosotros' ko 'por alguien'. A cikin Turanci, idan mai da wucewa ya fi murna ko ba ya da wahala ba, an kashe shi domin yin natural. Wata sauran alama ce 'has to be solved', wanda ya fi yin amfani da shi a cikin harshe.

examples.original: The rules can be changed.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ruːlz kæn biː tʃeɪndʒd/
examples.translation: Ana iya canje dawa da yadda ake canje.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'can be' don murna. A cikin Espanyol muna son 'se pueden cambiar'.

examples.original: The application must be completed before noon.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən mʌst biː kəmˈpliːtɪd bɪˈfɔːr nuːn/
examples.translation: Aikacewa ya dace da cirewa kafin noonin rana.
examples.note: 'Must be' yana nuna cewa ya bukata. A cikin Espanyol muna son 'debe + infinitive'.

examples.original: This issue should be addressed immediately.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈɪʃuː ʃʊd biː əˈdrest ɪˈmiːdiətli/
examples.translation: Wannan matsala ya kamata a cirewa da sauke nan da nan.
examples.note: 'Should be' don shawara. Yi tsallake da fadada 'should'.

examples.original: The meeting may be postponed if necessary.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ meɪ biː poʊstˈpoʊnd ɪf ˈnesəseri/
examples.translation: Ana iya canje da wucewa idan ya yiwu.
examples.note: 'May be' don murna. A cikin Espanyol ya fi yiwuwa 'puede ser'.

levels.label: Passive Gerunds and Infinitives
levels.translation: Gerunds da infinitives da yanzu da wucewa

examples.original: He dislikes being told what to do.
examples.phonetic: /hiː dɪsˈlaɪks ˈbiːɪŋ toʊld wɒt tə duː/
examples.translation: Ba ya son a yi masa shawara me yace.
examples.note: A cikin Espanyol muna son 'que le digan', while a Turanci muna son gerundio da yanzu da wucewa 'being told'.

examples.original: She is proud to be selected for the team.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz praʊd tə biː sɪˈlektɪd fɔːr ðə tiːm/
examples.translation: Ta yi farin ciki saboda a kan yi masa shawara domin kasancewa a cikin team.
examples.note: Yanzu da wucewa da infinitive 'to be selected' ya dace da 'ser seleccionada' a cikin Espanyol.

examples.original: The data needs to be analyzed carefully.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdeɪtə niːdz tə biː ˈænəlaɪzd ˈkerfəli/
examples.translation: Podcast ne suka bukata a kan a duba da yawa.
examples.note: 'Needs to be' + wucewa. A cikin Espanyol muna son 'necesita ser'.

examples.original: He admitted to being involved in the incident.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ədˈmɪtɪd tə ˈbiːɪŋ ɪnˈvɒlvd ɪn ðə ˈɪnsɪdənt/
examples.translation: Ya yarda da cewa ya shiga cikin wannan matsala.
examples.note: Yanzu da wucewa da gerund 'being involved' ya dace da 'estar implicado' a cikin Espanyol.

levels.label: Passive with Perfect Modals and Reporting Verbs
levels.translation: Yanzu da wucewa da modals da yawa da verbs na report

examples.original: The thief might have been caught by the police.
examples.phonetic: /ðə θiːf maɪt hæv biːn kɔːt baɪ ðə pəˈliːs/
examples.translation: Ya kamata ya iya kashewa da yadda ake kashewa da yadda ake kashewa da yadda ake kashewa da yadda.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'might have been' don nuna shawara game da sabon lokaci. A cikin Espanyol: 'podría haber sido'.

examples.original: The documents should have been signed yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒkjumənts ʃʊd hæv biːn saɪnd ˈjestərdeɪ/
examples.translation: Dokumentuna ya kamata a kan a sanya hannu a jiya.
examples.note: Yin shawara game da wani abu da ba a yi ba a baya. A cikin Espanyol: 'deberían haber sido'.

examples.original: The president is said to be considering new policies.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprezɪdənt ɪz sed tə biː kənˈsɪdərɪŋ nuː ˈpɒləsiz/
examples.translation: Ana yi masa shawara cewa shugaban ya yi shawara game da sabuwar siyasa.
examples.note: Tsarin da yake da verb na report: 'is said to be' + gerund. A cikin Espanyol muna son 'se dice que'.

examples.original: The lost city is believed to have been discovered in 2015.
examples.phonetic: /ðə lɒst ˈsɪti ɪz bɪˈliːvd tə hæv biːn dɪˈskʌvərd ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd ənd fɪfˈtiːn/
examples.translation: Ana yi masa shawara cewa an gano birnin da ya tsare a shekaru 2015.
examples.note: Yanzu da wucewa da 'be believed to + have been + wucewa' don nuna abubuwa da yawa.

title: Advanced Reported Speech / Tsarin Magana Inda ba ya yi wata sabon kalma ba
bridge: A cikin turanci, bayan bayyana magana da aka yi a cikin wasa, muna da bukatun sabon kalma (backshift) da ba za a iya amfani da wasu kalmomin da ba su da sabon kalma ba a turanci: 'She says she is tired' da 'She said she was tired'. Wani abu mai muhimmanci shi ne, a turanci an samu sabon kalma mai tsawon lokaci da yawa da yawa da yawa. Sabon kalma na wasu kalmomin kamar 'will' ya zama 'would', 'can' ya zama 'could', da wasu lokutan da suka yi sabon kalma (past simple → past perfect). Wani wasa mai yawa shi ne, a turanci ba a samu wasu kalmomin da suka yi sabon kalma a cikin wasa da yawa da yawa da yawa da yawa da yawa da yawa da yawa. 'Dijo que viniera' → 'He said to come' ko 'He said that I should come'), da kuma wasu kalmomin na lokaci da wuri suka yi sabon kalma mai tsawon lokaci (today → that day, here → there).
rule:
Don turanci (B2 level) da yawa da yawa:
1. **Backshift (sabon kalma na lokaci)**: Idan kalmar da aka yi da fahimta ta kasance a baya (said, told, asked), lokacin da aka bayyana magana, lokaci na cikin wasa ya yi sabon kalma: present simple → past simple; present continuous → past continuous; past simple → past perfect; present perfect → past perfect; will → would; can → could; may → might; must → had to (ko must idan yana nufin abu mai yawa).
2. **Babu backshift**: Ba zai yi sabon kalma ba idan maganar da aka bayyana ta kasance a baya ko da yawa da yawa da yawa da yawa da yawa da yawa da yawa. 'He said he is ill' (ya ci gaba da rashin lafiya) ko 'He said he was ill' (ba ya yi rashin lafiya ba).
3. **Sabbin kalmomin da suka yi sabon kalma na fasaha da fasaha**: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her', da sauransu.
4. **Sabbin kalmomin na lokaci da wuri**: today → that day; yesterday → the day before / the previous day; tomorrow → the next day / the following day; here → there; now → then.
5. **Tambayoyi da aka bayyana**: An canza tsarin tambaya zuwa cewa bayanai ne, da ake amfani da 'if/whether' don tambayoyi na 'yes/no', da kalmar da aka yi tambaya da ita. Ba a samu 'do/does/did' ba: 'Where does he live?' → 'She asked where he lived.'
6. **Orders da peticiones**: Ake amfani da 'tell/ask + object + infinitive': 'He told me to close the door.' Ba a samu 'that' ba.
7. **Verbs modal**: 'would', 'could', 'might', 'should', 'ought to' ba su yi sabon kalma. 'must' na iya kasancewa ko ya zama 'had to' depends on context.

concept_examples.text: She said she had finished the report the day before.
concept_examples.translation: Ta ce ta gama da rahoton da ta yi da shekaru.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː sed ʃiː hæd ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə rɪˈpɔːrt ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔːr/

concept_examples.text: He asked if I could help him with the project.
concept_examples.translation: Ya tambayi idan zai iya taimaka masa da aikin.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː æskt ɪf aɪ kʊd hɛlp hɪm wɪð ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt/

concept_examples.text: They told us to wait outside.
concept_examples.translation: Sun gaya mana mu jira a waje.

concept_examples.text: She warned that the meeting might be postponed.
concept_examples.translation: Ta gayyata cewa za a iya canza wata taron.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː wɔːrnd ðæt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ maɪt biː poʊstˈpoʊnd/

common_error.wrong: She said me that she was tired.
common_error.correct: She told me that she was tired.
common_error.correct_alt: She said that she was tired.
common_error.explanation: A turanci, 'say' ba zai iya da object na fasaha ba (me said), amma a turanci 'tell' ya kamata idan aka bayyana wa wane ne aka yi magana. Saboda haka, 'said me' ba daidai ba; ya kamata a yi 'told me' ko 'said' da ba a bayyana object ba.

levels.label: Statements with Backshift
levels.translation: Maganganun da suka yi sabon kalma na lokaci

examples.original: Paul said he was going to London the following day.
examples.phonetic: /pɔːl sɛd hiː wɒz ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ˈlʌndən ðə ˈfɒləʊɪŋ deɪ/
examples.translation: Paul ya ce zai tafi London da safe day after tomorrow.
examples.note: Duba sabon kalma: 'is going' → 'was going' da 'tomorrow' → 'the following day'.

examples.original: She mentioned she had already seen that film.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈmɛnʃənd ʃiː hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi siːn ðæt fɪlm/
examples.translation: Ta fada cewa ta gan da wata fim ya yi da shekaru da suka gabata.
examples.note: El present perfect 'have seen' retrocede a past perfect 'had seen'.

examples.original: They claimed they would finish the project by Friday.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ kleɪmd ðeɪ wʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.translation: Sun yarda cewa za su gama da aikin zuwa ranar Jumma.
examples.note: 'Will' se convierte en 'would' en estilo indirecto.

levels.label: Reported Questions
levels.translation: Tambayoyi a cikin tsarin magana inda ba ya yi wata sabon kalma ba

examples.original: She asked where the nearest bank was.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː æskt wɛə ðə ˈnɪərɪst bæŋk wɒz/
examples.translation: Ta tambayi inda ke cikin banki mai yawa.
examples.note: A tambayoyi masu bayyana, tsarin ya zama cewa: 'was' a karshe, ba 'was the bank' ba.

examples.original: He wondered if she had received his email.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ˈwʌndərd ɪf ʃiː hæd rɪˈsiːvd hɪz ˈiːmeɪl/
examples.translation: Ya yi nishadi idan ta karba da takarda ta.
examples.note: Para preguntas de sí/no se usa 'if' o 'whether'.

examples.original: They asked us why we hadn't called earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ æskt ʌs waɪ wiː ˈhædnt kɔːld ˈɜːrliər/
examples.translation: Sun tambayi meyasa ba mu ya kira da shekaru da suka gabata.
examples.note: La pregunta original 'Why didn't you call?' se convierte en 'why we hadn't called'.

levels.label: Reported Commands, Requests and Suggestions
levels.translation: Orders, tambayoyi da shawarwari a cikin tsarin magana inda ba ya yi wata sabon kalma ba

examples.original: The teacher told us to stop talking.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈtiːtʃər toʊld ʌs tə stɒp ˈtɔːkɪŋ/
examples.translation: Malamin ya gaya mana mu bar da magana.
examples.note: Muna amfani da 'tell + object + infinitive' don orders.

examples.original: She asked me to open the window.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː æskt miː tə ˈəʊpən ðə ˈwɪndəʊ/
examples.translation: Ta buƙatar ni buɗe tafkin.
examples.note: Para peticiones se usa 'ask + objeto + infinitivo'.

examples.original: He suggested going to the cinema.
examples.phonetic: /hiː səˈdʒɛstɪd ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ðə ˈsɪnəmə/
examples.translation: Ya shawarta mu tafi cinema.
examples.note: Para sugerencias, se puede usar el gerundio (suggest + -ing) o 'that + should'.

examples.original: She recommended that we book early.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˌrɛkəˈmɛndɪd ðæt wiː bʊk ˈɜːrli/
examples.translation: Ta shawarta mu auna da yaushe.
examples.note: Con 'recommend' se puede usar 'that + cláusula' con el verbo en forma base (subjuntivo).

translations.ha: Tsarin Magana Inda ba ya yi wata sabon kalma ba
